bullets: Added limited-offer models to every Freebuff access tier for the CLI model picker.
Fixed the CLI binary ignoring repository .env files so it no longer auto-loads .env or .env.local.
Removed the struck-through regular price from the Freebucks picker chip, now showing a single discounted price in accent colour.
Added prepaid annual subscription fields to session types to model one-time yearly checkouts.
Added a smoke test proving dotenv files cannot override the CLI smoke API URL.
Added X hashed email matching support for paid social conversions.
Renamed the ban-exempt constant and narrowed it to only waive a punishment flag and downgrade.
Removed the Imprezia ad provider module and restricted ad arms to gravity, first_party, and house.
Added an on-demand SDK compaction API with compactHistoryNow and compactRunState for manual history compaction.
Updated the streak perk copy to name the Pacific clock for daily Freebucks resets.
Named the unreachable session host on landing screen network failures instead of raw errors.
Raised the GLM 5.3 Flash price ceiling to 0.14/0.45.
Added a Supabase CPC format experiment module with a V3 invitation card.
Consolidated email hashing for Meta and paid-social CAPI senders into a shared hashMatchingEmail.
Bumped the Freebuff CLI release version to 0.0.180 as a version-only manifest update.
